name: academic-research-assistant
description: Evidence-grounded research, writing, analysis and academic artifacts with portable skills and local navigation tools.

interface.longDescription: Canonical methods for questions, evidence, design, analysis, writing, publication and academic artifacts. Local MCP provides read-only navigation and bundle consistency checks. Scientific execution uses actual host tools or optional Python helpers; no scholarly account or paid model connection is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Help me investigate a research question using available evidence.
Review my research design and prepare a reproducible workflow.
Help me write and verify an academic artifact.
